vessels/vessel-lucky-cat.png:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: assembled, CLOSED vessel master for Time Capsule app, to be separated into animation layers.
Input image: design/art/style-sheet.png is the approved style reference. Match its ink, palette, paper grain and visual weight exactly.
Create one ORIGINAL folk-style beckoning-cat figurine, a warm ivory/cream ceramic cat with plum and brass accents, a friendly expression, one raised paw clearly jointed at the shoulder so it can sway as a separate layer. The cat sits on a small brass-and-plum rectangular plinth with a discreet shallow drawer in its front; the drawer is fully CLOSED, with a simple unmarked brass pull. Draw the whole object completely, including all visible details, so the paw can be isolated and the drawer can slide forward. A small plain round brass coin may be held in the other paw, entirely blank with NO text, engraving or insignia. Avoid any recognizable character, specific commercial lucky-cat design, brand markings, symbols, or patterned coin.
Composition: single square canvas, front three-quarter view, cat and base centred, widest extent at most about 70% of width, top clear by at least 10%, base near 88% height; genuine transparent background. Keep edges crisp at 120 px.
Original design, no logos, no brand names or brand shapes, no characters, no text.

App: 時光膠囊 / Time Capsule. People send a sealed letter that can only be opened at a set time and place. Mood: tender, human, nostalgic, "precious in the AI age". Hand-inked storybook, not glossy 3D.
- Clean ink line art with a slightly hand-drawn line, flat colour fills plus one soft shading tone, a little paper grain, light hatching only (it must still read at about 120 px). Lines in plum #6E2B3F or navy #16263F.
- Palette only: ink blue #2F5D8A, light blue #5A8FD0, glass blue #DCE8F2, plum #6E2B3F, brass #C9A15A, wax red #A3364F, navy #16263F, paper #F6F8FB, cream #F3E2BB. Warm brown wood is allowed for wooden objects.
- Front three-quarter view, soft top-left light. No text, letters, numbers, logos or real brands.
- Transparent background, object centred, generous padding (object fills about 70% of the canvas), square.
Match the attached style sheet exactly.
